named_question: Which numerically duplicated stored mood identities make native first-match lookup ambiguous?

static_byte_pins.purpose: SID lookup walks record pointers in order and returns the first signed32 +0xa4 match.
CID lookup walks the same collection and returns the first signed32 +0xa8 match.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting inspect FILE BLOCK
CLI_policy.diagnostics: duplicate_mood_sid for repeated positive signed32 SIDs; duplicate_mood_cid for repeated nonzero signed32 CIDs. Compare numeric values, including plus/zero-padded equivalent spellings; identify the extra record's exact path and first matching direct record.
CLI_policy.scope: Only direct LightsceneC records in exactly one direct LightscenesC. Never join separate containers, nested decoys or other blocks. Count mismatch does not hide a stored duplicate; this is not a loaded/imported-record prediction.
CLI_policy.zero: Repeated CID0 and zero SID are excluded. Existing zero-SID reconciliation diagnostics remain separate. Missing, opaque and out-of-signed32 storage is retained and outside this duplicate check.
CLI_policy.formats: Structured diagnostics in JSON and visible diagnostics on stderr for table/CSV, including --quiet/--no-header.
CLI_policy.preservation: Read-only. No normalization, renumbering, default insertion, repair or file writes.
CLI_policy.admission_limit: Absence of duplicate diagnostics is not uniqueness across unsupported values, valid import, full GUI editability or transaction admission.
